pages.title: Paired Mats
pages.text: Woven straw floor mats for Gensokyo-style interiors. Place tatami while holding 2 or more mats and it lays a connected pair at once, consuming 2: a FRONT half joined to an END half facing it.

With a single mat in hand, or no free space ahead, you place a lone SQUARE mat instead. Break either half of a pair and the survivor relaxes back into a single square mat; each half drops one tatami item.$(br2)The full-height tatami block pairs up exactly the same way.
